subject: ENG103
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos, 5 for each language, covering all specified topics. For English, selections were driven by high view counts from authoritative channels like Google, Scribbr, and Khan Academy. For Arabic, selections also prioritized high-view, comprehensive tutorials. In one Arabic topic, only a single candidate passed the hard gates, but it was a strong fit. All constraints, including no duplicate videos, were met.

coverage.note: Most candidates failed duration, relevance, or view count gates.

videos.title: How to Write a Summary
videos.filter_reason: A highly popular (2.9M views) and concise video that directly teaches the core principles of writing an effective summary.

videos.title: How to Paraphrase in 5 Easy Steps | Scribbr 🎓
videos.filter_reason: From Scribbr, an authority on academic integrity, this video has massive reach (2M views) and provides a clear, step-by-step guide to paraphrasing, the key skill for avoiding plagiarism.

videos.title: How to Write a Resume | For Freshers & Experienced People (Step-by-Step Tutorial)
videos.filter_reason: With over 10 million views, this is a massively peer-validated, comprehensive step-by-step tutorial suitable for both freshers and experienced individuals.

videos.title: Cover Letter Strategies to Impress Employers | Recruiter Tips | Google Career Certificates
videos.filter_reason: From 'Grow with Google' with over 12 million views, this video offers authoritative and widely trusted advice on crafting a compelling cover letter from a recruiter's perspective.

videos.title: How to Build Your Own Portfolio Website in Minutes with AI ! 🤯
videos.filter_reason: This highly-viewed tutorial (810k views) provides a modern and accessible approach for students by teaching how to build a portfolio website quickly using AI tools.
